judgments.reason: The vignette explicitly states the patient 'sustained a dog bite on her right thumb approximately one week before admission,' which directly supports the dog bite as the source/etiology in the completed diagnosis label.

The vignette states 'Gram stain showed thin, fusiform gram-negative rods in two of four bottles,' which is consistent with Capnocytophaga canimorsus morphology and supports the microbiological basis of the diagnosis.
